title: 第1423章 乾源一脉的执掌者李越小友第1422章 千分之一绝灭之地意志大哭哀求
slug: 全民成野神唯有我百倍供品
content_zh:
第1423章乾源一脉的执掌者，李越小友
“说实话吧。”
“你确定只盘点过两次宝库？”
李越眯着眼睛，看着被镇压在地的女子，怀疑道。
“真的啊！”
“哥！你要相信我！”
“我‘灭绝婉儿’绝不说谎！”
女子泪流满面，哽咽道。
“这样吧。”
“除了那座‘生死熔炉’外。”
“你再拿出三件和那一颗剑果、帝君果同等品质的至宝，我带你离开绝灭之地。”
李越想了想，开口道。
“真的？”
‘灭绝婉儿’脱口而出。
李越立即眯起了眼睛。
果然！
此女口中没有半句真话。
恐怕都不知道盘点过几次宝库，偷偷藏了几件至宝！
不过时间还长。
不急。

一次性逼太紧了，对方怕是会很不舒服。
一旦逆反乃至破罐子破摔之类，那会很难办。
温水煮青蛙，一点点把对方的家底掏干净，这才是正道。
“千真万确。”
他点了点头。
“不过要等你带我离开绝灭之地后，我才能给你！”
女子补充道。
“自然。”
“我也同样要在离开绝灭之地后，才会让你离开这里。”
李越赞同，微笑道。
‘灭绝婉儿’放心了。
她已经盘算着。
等对方放她离开这里后——
她一定要将自己的宝物统统抢回来，另外将那颗剑果和帝君果也抢走！
content_en:
Chapter 1423 The leader of the Qianyuan lineage, little friend Li Yue
"Tell the truth."
"Are you sure you've only inventoried the treasure house twice?"
Li Yue squinted his eyes, looked at the woman who was suppressed on the ground, and said suspiciously.
"Really!"
"Brother! You have to believe me!"
"I, 'Mie Mie Wan'er', will never lie!"
The woman choked with tears streaming down her face.
"So be it."
"Except for the 'furnace of life and death'."
"You take out three more treasures of the same quality as the Sword Fruit and the Emperor Fruit, and I will take you out of the Land of Extinction."
Li Yue thought for a while and said.
"Really?"
‘Mie Mie Wan’er’ blurted out.
Li Yue immediately narrowed his eyes.
really!
There is not a single word of truth in this woman's mouth.
I’m afraid I don’t even know how many times I have taken inventory of the treasure house and secretly hid a few treasures!
But it’s still a long time.
No rush.
If you press too hard at once, the other party may feel very uncomfortable.
Once you rebel or even break the pot, it will be difficult to deal with it.
Boiling a frog in warm water and cleaning up the other party's wealth bit by bit is the right way.
"Absolutely true."
He nodded.
"But I can't give it to you until you take me out of the Land of Extinction!"
the woman added.
"Natural."
"I will also let you leave here after leaving the Land of Extinction."
Li Yue agreed and smiled.
‘Mie Mie Wan’er’ was relieved.
She was already planning.
After the other party lets her leave here——
She must snatch back all her treasures, and also snatch away the Sword Fruit and Emperor Fruit!
